name: chr1
key_challenge: Human SNP/repeat baseline; only target with real-read variant truth (GIAB)

reference.notes: VERIFY current GRCh38 patch level at NCBI before download. chr1 sequence NC_000001.11 is stable across patches. Keep full GRCh38 available as mapping target so off-target mismapping is captured.

simulation.command: dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 30 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/reference.fasta reads && mv reads.bwa.read1.fastq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads.bwa.read2.fastq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz
simulation.notes: Map simulated reads against full GRCh38, not just chr1, to exercise off-target mismapping

real_reads.description: GIAB HG001/NA12878 ~300x 2x148bp Illumina WGS. Required for variant accuracy (VA) component of CAS.
real_reads.eval_notes: Align to full GRCh38; restrict evaluation to chr1 intersected with GIAB high-confidence BED. Call variants with GATK HaplotypeCaller (pinned version). See AGENTS.md.

truth.simulated: dwgsim read name encodes true origin coordinates; evaluate with paftools.js mapeval
truth.variant: GIAB truth VCF GRCh38 + high-confidence BED (--giab only)

benchmark_notes: Primary human baseline. Simulated reads give mapping accuracy (PA, MCS). Real GIAB reads give variant accuracy (VA). VA is only defined for this target.
